name: Fluids + falling blocks (pilot)
source: docs/PARITY-SWEEP.md §6 — pilot run 2026-11-22, checks only, no fixes. Scope: falling blocks, lava, water-source mechanics. Excluded (owned by fix/1.21.7-water-flow): vertical water fall and horizontal water flow spread.
method: javap -c on the named 1.21.7 server jar for every vanilla method in scope, exhaustive jar scans (waterlogging 355/355; falling classes 23/23, 2/2, 1/1, 16/16, 3/3; tag inventory 196 block / 2 fluid tags), plus Rust unit tests (cargo test -p horizon-world --lib level::tests::, dev profile, -j 1: 77 passed, 15 failed). Java-oracle harness drivers could NOT be run (no .local/minecraft/1.21.7/ in any worktree) — see Batch 0.

items.title: Bubble columns never form; existing ones decay to water
items.evidence: Formation/survival key on absent bubble-column tags (enables_bubble_column_push_up, enables_bubble_column_drag_down, bubble_column_can_occupy do not exist in the 1.21.7 jar); no SoulSand/Magma hook in level/. Entity-motion side correct but moot.

items.title: Concrete powder falling into water does not solidify on contact
items.evidence: Vanilla runs the landing branch at the first water cell (javap); the port always passes stuck_in_water=false, so powder sinks to the lakebed. Landing/neighbour solidification otherwise exact.

items.title: Lava random-tick fire spread walks through solid blocks
items.evidence: Vanilla stops at the first blocksMotion() block; the port stops only for the absent blocks_lava_fire_spread tag. The walk also perturbs the RNG stream after the first motion-blocking block.

items.title: Lava ignition ignores doFireTick
items.evidence: The port carries the 26.3 gamerule table with no doFireTick; with it off, vanilla lava never ignites but the port still does near players. A gamerule-table gap, not lava-specific — needs a version-table decision, not a lava-local fix.

items.title: NO fluid spreading at all, water or lava
items.evidence: Vanilla FlowingFluid.canHoldAnyFluid is hardcoded (air passes); the port used the absent tag washed_away_by_fluids, so spread never fired. RAN: lava_meets_water fails (air where cobblestone should be), plus 6 more fluid tests fail.
items.fix: ee7ab396 (merged 2026-11-22) — restored the vanilla 1.21.7 list form, bytecode-verified; water tests 12/12 pass

items.title: Dripstone never transfers fluid to cauldrons
items.evidence: All stalactite predicates require the absent tag minecraft:speleothems. Constants and delay match vanilla but never run. RAN: dripstone_fills_cauldrons fails (cauldron[] vs water_cauldron[level=1]). Same cause also kills falling stalactites (out of scope, noted).

systemic_note: Four of the six defects (G1, G3, G5, G6) share one root cause: the 1.21.7 port carries 26.x tag-based logic for lookups whose tags do not exist in vanilla 1.21.7, and every such lookup silently degrades to empty/false (block tags: unwrap_or_default at level/data.rs:397; fluid tags: empty mask at level/data.rs:824-835). The prepared .local data is faithful to the jar — the port code, not the data, is the 26.x carry-over.
out_of_scope_failures: 7 level::tests failures NOT diagnosed by the pilot (copper chest, crops, doors/beds, levers, pistons, redstone, snowy grass) — hypothesis only that the same tag pattern may extend to them. Owned by their respective batches (redstone/pistons -> Batch 2).
